notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Loops through resolved IPs and queries shodan host for each. Returns open ports, service banners, SSL details, and CVE flags per IP — passive enrichment that provides service inventory without a single port scan.

=== PASSIVE VALUE ===
Shodan data may be days/weeks old but still provides: open port inventory, software versions, known vulnerabilities flagged by Shodan. Identifies the high-value target (many open ports = complex attack surface) without touching it.
